featured_reviews.name: anisha dcruz
featured_reviews.review_text:
Kids Gurukulam offers a structured curriculum and focuses on building early academic skills. My son was part of the school for 3 years, and during this time I have seen that the activities and exposure provided are very good for young learners. The field trips are varied and truly educational including visits to places like the zoo, police station, fire station, and the racecourse, among others. These experiences combine learning with fun which is a wonderful approach at this age.

The teachers are generally understanding and cooperative when parents raise concerns and are willing to respond and work towards resolving issues.

However, as a parent I did notice that there were moments when my child felt a bit anxious about school particularly around writing tasks. At this age children benefit greatly from a gentle and encouraging approach, along with patience and understanding as writing skills take time to develop. I feel emotional comfort is just as important as academic progress in the early years.

That said, every child’s experience can differ and parental involvement at home also plays a role. I appreciate the effort the school puts into its overall program.

featured_reviews.name: azhar ali
featured_reviews.review_text:
A home away from home for our little one — and our hearts! ❤️

Our son Adyan started here when he was just 2 years old — a tiny little guy holding our hands tightly, nervous and shy. Today, he's 5 and has successfully completed his academic year along with daycare. And honestly, every time I drop him off, my heart still feels full, not heavy.

Watching him grow over these past 3 years has been emotional in the best way. He went from crying at the gate to running inside with a big smile. From barely speaking in class to confidently singing rhymes and making friends.

A huge part of this journey belongs to the incredible teachers who poured their love into Adyan. A very special thank you to Kanisha Teacher — your warmth, patience, and care have meant the world to us. You made Adyan feel safe and seen, and we are so deeply grateful for you.

We also want to thank Mansi Teacher, Snehal Teacher, Prachi Teacher, Bina Teacher, and Sabrin Teacher for their kindness and dedication. And to all the didis who looked after him with so much love — thank you for every hug, every smile, and every little moment that made his days brighter.

A heartfelt thank you as well to our wonderful Principal Aditi Mam for leading such a nurturing and loving school. Your vision and warmth are felt in every corner, and we are so grateful for the beautiful environment you've created.

This preschool became his second family. I've seen the joy in his eyes every single day. As a parent, there's no greater relief and happiness than knowing your child is safe, loved, and happy when you're not with them.

Thank you, from the bottom of my heart, for taking such beautiful care of Adyan for the past 3 years. You've shaped his childhood in the most wonderful way. 🌸

— A deeply grateful dad (Adyan's father)

featured_reviews.review_text:
"आमच्या मुलीने गेल्या डिसेंबरमध्ये 'लिटिल चॅम्प्स' मध्ये प्रवेश घेतला आणि तेव्हापासून तिचा प्रवास अतिशय कौतुकास्पद आहे. शाळेत दर आठवड्याला होणारे उपक्रम आणि सणांचे नियोजन खरोखरच अप्रतिम असते.
​विशेषतः दसरा, मकर संक्रांत, शिवजयंती, मराठी भाषा दिवस, ख्रिसमस आणि गुढीपाडवा यांसारख्या सणांचे ज्या उत्साहात आयोजन केले जाते, त्यातून मुलांना आपल्या संस्कृतीची खूप छान ओळख होत आहे.
​शाळेच्या दैनंदिन दिनचर्येत मुलांच्या सर्वांगीण विकासावर खूप चांगले लक्ष दिले जाते. आता आमची मुलगी:
​पेन/पेन्सिल पकडणे (Pencil Grip) आणि Straight, Slanting व Sleeping lines काढण्याचा सराव उत्तम करत आहे.
​१ ते १० पर्यंत अंक मोजणे आणि योग्य प्रकारे अभिवादन (Greetings) करायला शिकली आहे.
​पेपर क्राफ्ट, शॅडो प्ले, लीफ आर्ट आणि कलरिंग यांसारख्या कलागुणांमुळे तिची कल्पकता वाढली आहे.
​पॉटी ट्रेनिंग (Potty Training) आणि नियमित व्यायामामुळे तिच्या शिस्तीत आणि शारीरिक हालचालीत सकारात्मक बदल दिसत आहेत.
​नुकताच झालेला 'किड्स गॅदरिंग' सोहळा अतिशय सुंदर आणि नियोजनबद्ध होता. 'लिटिल चॅम्प्स' मधील सर्व शिक्षक आणि कर्मचारी मुलांशी खूप मायेने वागतात, त्याबद्दल त्यांचे मनापासून आभार!"
